profile.address: 85 Broad St, 17th Floor, New York, NY 10004
profile.summary: Code Nation, formerly known as ScriptEd, is a New York-based nonprofit that teaches coding to students in under-resourced high schools. Volunteer software professionals teach the courses, and the program connects students to careers in technology. It works with schools in New York City and the San Francisco Bay Area.

sources.title: Code Nation Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica
ScriptEd Announces Name Change to Code Nation

review.notes: ProPublica (Code Nation Inc, EIN 46-0557527, New York), the ScriptEd mission page (85 Broad St, volunteer teachers, NYC and Bay Area, 'formerly known as Code Nation') and the 2018 Patch article all match the agenda's 'ScriptEd Inc., dba Code Nation', New York location, and a coding-education contract. The website codenation.org is only supported by a 2018 article and returns 503; scripted.org now appears to be the active site, so the website is unconfirmed. The summary's 'formerly known as ScriptEd' direction is outdated since the current site says ScriptEd is the current name, but the substantive claims are supported.
